results.title: The Little Mermaid
results.overview: When a heartbroken woman seeks revenge on her married lover’s family, his daughter mistakes her for a mermaid.

results.title: A Superhero's Father
results.overview: When his superhero son rallies the town to search for a missing woman, a lonely father demands he first fix the leak in his bedroom.

results.title: Sanxingdui: Future Past
results.overview: In the future, humanity receives a mysterious fragmentary intergalactic warning: Jiang Cheng and an ally must collect six Sanxingdui artifacts to complete the information, ultimately uncovering the secret that the female astronaut Xi Ling traveled back to the ancient Shu period, thereby reflecting the position of the Sanxingdui civilization in the origins of world civilization and the pattern of pluralistic unity of Chinese civilization.

results.title: Carta a uma Jovem Escritora
results.overview: Carta a Uma Jovem Escritora is a reflection on memory and forgetting, presented through five striking portraits of five Portuguese women writers: Olga Gonçalves, Graça Pina de Morais, Maria Cecília Correia, Alice Sampaio, and Maria Amélia Neto.

results.title: Need and Desire
results.overview: A gesture of erasure. A spell. If you lift the emulsion from a photograph, destroy its surface, transplant it onto a new body, does the memory it carried survive? Need and Desire originates from this question, and from the poetic belief that making a film can alter reality. The cinematic act becomes incantation: a process that destroys and reconstructs simultaneously. Still memories become an “emulsional” landscape. Need and Desire is a cameraless handmade film exploring the materiality of emulsion through instant photographs lifted and transplanted onto a Super 8 polyester base of recycled film scraps.

results.title: The Puzzle of Pain: RIP Van Winkle
results.original_title: The Puzzle of Pain: RIP Van Winkle
results.overview: Appropriated from the classic Terry Toon animation, we watch events unfold of a lethargic hunter under a tree, beaten with a rolling pin multiple times by his wife for his laziness. Is this character invincible? Are they subject only to the idea of pain but not actually experiencing it? What is pain in the world of animation? Witness the breakdown of both the image and pain vs the suspension of disbelief in this tongue-in-cheek portrayal of violence in classic cartoons.

results.title: Pepper
results.overview: Told through athletes in moments of focus, Pepper examines the self, homeopathy and the pressure of time passing. The first film of Goes Electric, a new series of experimental documentaries about reality and pseudoscience, Pepper centres on the conflict between the demands of performance and the realities of the mind. Constructed from hand‑painted and electrocuted black‑and‑white 16mm film, the project is produced through Autocolour, a self-developed colour film process using only black-and-white chemistry and ink to produce colour images. Each frame is rotoscoped and combined across three passes of 16mm film, creating a controlled, saturated image that anchors the film’s material approach.

results.title: an active dying
results.overview: an active dying is an experimental film that utilizes film’s position as a dying medium to explore what dying is. I came to the conclusion that there is an active state of dying and an inactive one. That active state is like a crescendo of ever increasing importance, and change. It's a dying star, creating a supernova, blowing you up from the inside. If you survive, you still feel the pressure of the star inside you, you aren't able to ignore it as you did before you knew of its precarious nature. An active dying recreates this experience with film texture, colour and flicker.

results.title: The Minotaur
results.overview: The Minotaur is a retelling of the Greek myth about a half man / half bull who is imprisoned in a labyrinth by King Minos. The film is made from 35mm slides found on eBay, each with a drawing scratched into the surface. Employing 2,500 drawings, The Minotaur took 10 months to make—having gone through several early forms including as a computer game and a clumsy animation made solely from mosaics. Music written and performed by Stephen Crowe.

results.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
results.overview: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

results.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
results.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

results.title: Cuddle Café
results.overview: In a world where loneliness has become ordinary and warmth is something humans buy with money, the protagonist lives a life that does not move forward. Instead of solving the problems that weigh on him, he chooses ignorance and quiet laziness. One evening after work, he steps into a Cuddle Café. What happens next becomes the story.

results.title: The Visitor
results.overview: Every morning, for a while, Willow Damiani has been waking up on her backyard lawn. She can't remember why or how but when odd occurrences start to happen and a strange figure begins visiting her every night, she begins to question what is real and what isn't.

results.title: Heirloom
results.overview: After receiving an heirloom sauce recipe from his late father, a grieving son is consumed by his obsession with growing tomatoes.

results.title: Auditions
results.overview: A film school is holding an aptitude exam for its directing program. Güney, the last candidate of the day, is called into the room. What begins as an ordinary student interview gradually spirals out of control when his ex-girlfriend arrives. As the jury’s familiar questions give way to personal reckonings, the examination room becomes a courtroom where it is no longer clear who is judging whom.

results.title: Winter Wonderlanes
results.overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

results.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
results.overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

results.title: You Know I Love You
results.overview: In Mexico City, during a visit to their patriarchal grandparents' house, rebellious seven-year-old Lucía and her siblings will stumble upon something that will change their lives forever: their grandfather's revolver.

results.title: Border Diaries
results.overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.
